已查到可引用的部分資料：

A direct AI-market-to-test-solution source: the current AI server ecosystem mapping only preserves sales / test-solution leads and does not represent formal product configuration, customer relationship, or verified opportunity [2].
It also adds R&S solution mapping but does not provide measurement conditions that can replace formal specifications [1].
Formal R&S product evidence for the signaling side: CMX500 is documented as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for device testing across LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD [4][5].
Formal R&S feature / option evidence for signaling claims: CMX500 documented capabilities include NR FR1 / FR2 signaling, LTE signaling, NB-IoT / NB-NTN signaling, WLAN signaling, fading, AWGN, BLER, throughput and PER measurements, plus remote-control interfaces [4].
Formal R&S evidence for non-signaling claims: CMP180 is positioned for WLAN production non-signaling RF testing, with support for Wi-Fi 6E, Wi-Fi 7 and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, bandwidths up to 500 MHz, and single-box 2x2 MIMO testing [33][34].
Competitor evidence from official or third-party sources, not only R&S battle cards: the Anritsu comparison tables state that battle cards lack formal CMX500 RFU18 or Anritsu module datasheets and that both sides’ FR3 numbers need formal datasheet validation [23].
Competitor product specifications with version, hardware configuration and conditions: the Keysight comparison notes that competitor portfolio, architecture, software model, Wi-Fi, RedCap and FR3 / 6G statements lack official datasheets, versioning, order data, configuration documents or release status [31].
Avoid using battle-card slogans as specifications: “industry’s only,” “fully integrated,” “long-term scalability” and similar positioning language are identified as sales language that needs verification through formal datasheets, feature documents, conformance reports or configuration tools [30].
Avoid treating PR demonstrations as binding measurements: FR3 / RFU18 demos lack throughput, bandwidth, MCS index, software version, detailed hardware specs or measurement uncertainty, so they are only PR / demonstration-level evidence [17][18].
For configuration-sensitive claims, use formal configurator or datasheet evidence: RFU18 upgrade and data-rate claims require RFU18 datasheet / configuration-tool confirmation and cannot be backfilled into earlier CMX500 formal specifications [36].
For certification or conformance comparisons, require validated / aligned test-case, accreditation or package evidence: the Amarisoft comparison flags that claims about PTCRB / GCF aligned tests, operator acceptance, validated NTN, and production scaling need formal option, accreditation, validation-report or platform-spec evidence [11][12].
【推論】A supportable AI comparison would therefore need one source tying the AI use case to the tester requirement, formal R&S signaling / non-signaling product and option evidence, and formal competitor evidence under the same measurement conditions; the current AI mapping is only a sales lead, while the competitor comparisons are largely battle-card positioning with stated documentation gaps [1][2][23][30][31].

AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping › 與既有知識的關係
- [[R&S PCB test solutions]] 提供 2026.3.4 R&S high-speed digital 簡報中的 PCB fabricator / system house 測試流程；本頁則來自市場 Excel，將 R&S 儀器與 AI server supply-chain 類別做銷售 mapping。
- [[高頻高速 PCB 測試解決方案]] 與 [[Dk-Df]]、[[Delta-L]]、[[TDR 阻抗測量]] 已有 Keysight / PCB test 圖像來源；本頁新增 R&S 方案對應，但未提供可替代正式規格的量測條件。
- [[AI 伺服器 PCB 供應鏈升級]] 記錄材料與板層升級；本頁只補充對應測試入口，例如 IL、TDR、high speed trace、PDN Target Z。
- [[資料中心電力電子生態系]]、[[NVIDIA 800V HVDC 架構]] 與 [[AI 資料中心高壓直流供電]] 記錄 data center power electronics；本頁補充 [[MXO]]、[[R&S FSWP]]、[[ZISO]] 與 BMS test 的 sales mapping 線索。

AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping
[[AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping]] 是用來保存 [[AISeverEcosystem]] 中 AI server ecosystem 分類與 [[R&S Solution]] 欄位對應關係的概念頁；它只表示該 Excel 表中的銷售 / 測試方案線索，不代表正式產品配置、客戶關係或已驗證商機。

AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping › 相關來源
- [[AISeverEcosystem]] — AISeverEcosystem.xlsx 的 lossy markdown 轉檔摘要，保存 ServerRack 與 ICs 兩張表中的供應鏈分類、公司列名、R&S solution 與未決限制。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

CMX500 Callbox › Example Callbox use cases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 的 Example Callbox use cases 進一步列出：

- R&D verification of new bands。
- Sensitivity testing。
- [[RedCap]]。
- [[CMX500 Desense Testing]]。
- [[3GPP Pre-Conformance Testing]]。
- [[CMX500 SRS RF measurements]]。
- UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements。
- UL TX Switching。
- [[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]]。
- High e2e TP testing。
- Non-signaling verification。

CMX500 Callbox › Testing phases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 將測試階段放在下列脈絡中：

- [[Go-NoGo Testing]]。
- [[Non-Sig Testing]]。
- [[Conformance Testing]]。
- [[R&D Testing]]。

來源未明確說這四者是完整 lifecycle，也未定義各階段 pass/fail 標準。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › 核心 thesis
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26），R&S 對 [[amarisoft]] 的核心定位是：[[R&S CMX500]] 與 R&S radio communication tester portfolio 提供 instrument-grade、validated、calibrated、可延伸至 production 的 5G testing path；[[amarisoft]] 則被描述為 COTS hardware + software-defined stack 的 functional testing solution。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › Sales landmines
[[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 建議用以下問題區分需求：

1. 是否需要 calibrated [[FR2]] / [[mmWave]] testing？
2. 是否需要 global support、multi-year warranty 或 calibration services？
3. 是否需要 [[Operator Acceptance]]、[[Conformance Testing]] 或 pre-conformance？
4. 是否需要 validated / [[PTCRB]] / [[GCF]] aligned test cases，而不只是 functional simulation？
5. 是否需要 non-signaling ATE 或 multi-port production test？
6. 是否需要 integrated [[Wi-Fi signaling]]（6/6E/7）？
7. 是否需要 factory line 的 non-signaling test capability？
8. 是否需要 3GPP RF pre-conformance 或 aligned test coverage？

Anritsu
[[Anritsu]] 是一間日本 test & measurement vendor；在 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中被描述為 R&S radio communication tester portfolio 的競品供應商。

Anritsu › Battle card 中的公司輪廓
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26）：

- Headquarters：Kanagawa, Japan。
- Company size：約 4,000+ employees global。
- Market positioning：source 稱其在 Japan T&M market share 為 #1，但 global footprint 較弱。
- Strengths：good LTE/eCall signaling（[[Anritsu MD8475B]]）、solid RF heritage、strong Japanese operator relationships。
- Support model：traditional hardware service；source 評為 software ecosystem 較弱、cloud capabilities limited，且 TestDeck 是唯一 DX tool。

以上為 R&S internal battle card 對競品的描述；來源未引用 Anritsu 官方文件或第三方市場資料。

FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張 › 來源主張
- 來源說 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] successfully validated high-throughput performance of a [[5G NR]] connection at **13 GHz**。
- 來源明示 proposed [[FR3]] frequency range 為 **7.125 GHz to 24.25 GHz**。
- 來源說 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 的 5G mobile test platform（MTP）使用 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] in a maximum throughput use case at 13 GHz。
- 來源稱該 achievement confirms the potential of [[FR3]] to deliver high data rates using high [[MCS]]，並透過 [[4x4 MIMO]] enhanced capacity。
- 來源未提到 [[RFU18]]，也未提供 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 13 GHz hardware / software configuration。

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness]]（來源未標示 published date；raw created 2026-09-11；demo 日期 March 2 to 5, 2026）：

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › Sales landmines

5. 是否需要 advanced CA 或 mobility without adding extra boxes？
6. 是否需要 FR3 testing beyond 16 GHz，以支援 emerging 6G FR3 evaluations？

A direct AI-market-to-test-solution source: the current AI server ecosystem mapping only preserves sales / test-solution leads and does not represent formal product configuration, customer relationship, or verified opportunity [2].
It also adds R&S solution mapping but does not provide measurement conditions that can replace formal specifications [1].
Formal R&S product evidence for the signaling side: CMX500 is documented as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for device testing across LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD [4][5].
Formal R&S feature / option evidence for signaling claims: CMX500 documented capabilities include NR FR1 / FR2 signaling, LTE signaling, NB-IoT / NB-NTN signaling, WLAN signaling, fading, AWGN, BLER, throughput and PER measurements, plus remote-control interfaces [4].
Formal R&S evidence for non-signaling claims: CMP180 is positioned for WLAN production non-signaling RF testing, with support for Wi-Fi 6E, Wi-Fi 7 and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, bandwidths up to 500 MHz, and single-box 2x2 MIMO testing [33][34].
Competitor evidence from official or third-party sources, not only R&S battle cards: the Anritsu comparison tables state that battle cards lack formal CMX500 RFU18 or Anritsu module datasheets and that both sides’ FR3 numbers need formal datasheet validation [23].
Competitor product specifications with version, hardware configuration and conditions: the Keysight comparison notes that competitor portfolio, architecture, software model, Wi-Fi, RedCap and FR3 / 6G statements lack official datasheets, versioning, order data, configuration documents or release status [31].
Avoid using battle-card slogans as specifications: “industry’s only,” “fully integrated,” “long-term scalability” and similar positioning language are identified as sales language that needs verification through formal datasheets, feature documents, conformance reports or configuration tools [30].
Avoid treating PR demonstrations as binding measurements: FR3 / RFU18 demos lack throughput, bandwidth, MCS index, software version, detailed hardware specs or measurement uncertainty, so they are only PR / demonstration-level evidence [17][18].
For configuration-sensitive claims, use formal configurator or datasheet evidence: RFU18 upgrade and data-rate claims require RFU18 datasheet / configuration-tool confirmation and cannot be backfilled into earlier CMX500 formal specifications [36].
For certification or conformance comparisons, require validated / aligned test-case, accreditation or package evidence: the Amarisoft comparison flags that claims about PTCRB / GCF aligned tests, operator acceptance, validated NTN, and production scaling need formal option, accreditation, validation-report or platform-spec evidence [11][12].
【推論】A supportable AI comparison would therefore need one source tying the AI use case to the tester requirement, formal R&S signaling / non-signaling product and option evidence, and formal competitor evidence under the same measurement conditions; the current AI mapping is only a sales lead, while the competitor comparisons are largely battle-card positioning with stated documentation gaps [1][2][23][30][31].
